about: The librarian's briefing pack, measured in a real session: two sub-agents of the accountant's session started the same job (a new incident.stories@ orienting itself), one from ten whole files, one from three files of the pack, then answered the same eight questions. The tokens are each sub-agent's own, from its transcript (tools/accounts-measure.mjs, subagents.each). One run of each: a first measurement, not an average.
pack_built_from: tools/library-pack.mjs at commit 3171210, built in the accountant's clone

missing_from_the_pack: who merges to main (it is in CLAUDE.md, which the harness loads anyway)
rows of the same minute are lettered in the order written, a new one goes below

result.estimate_note: bytes / 4 undercounts here: the whole files measured 2.39 bytes a token, the pack 1.62 (state.json is dense), so the saving is 64%, not 75%
result.carried_on_every_later_call: what a session reads at its start is read again from the cache on every later call: 25,611 tokens saved at the start is 25,611 cache-read tokens saved per call after it (arithmetic from the measured figure; a session's number of calls is its own)
result.floor: a sub-agent's first call carried 63,800 tokens and a full session's 84,717 before reading anything (the harness, its tools, CLAUDE.md): the pack cannot reduce that part

limits: sub-agents, not full sessions (a full session's floor is higher)
eight questions on the rules; not a test of doing the job
